# Risk Data Library Metadata Editor

The Metadata Editor can be run by accessing the `RDL_MDE.html` file using a web browser.

## Development

An development environment which provides integration tests and linting is available.

### Installation

Run `npm install` to install the development environment.

### Linting

Execute `npm run lint` to run linting checks. Note, currently the linting finds plenty of issues with the code. Ideally this would be resolved.

### Tests

Execute `npm run test` to run the integration test. Note there would be scope to expand these limited integration tests to more comprehensive unit testing, but would require significant refactoring of the code.
